title: Public Sesh discovery page
purpose: Expose the locked SESH-055 anonymous public-project discovery service through one server-rendered human discovery surface.
emptyState: An empty explicit-public collection is a successful 200 response.
The empty state does not imply whether private projects exist.
privacyBoundary: Project id may appear only as the canonical public project route identifier and is not rendered as visible page text.
Creator handle may appear only in its canonical vanity href and is not rendered as visible page text on discovery cards.
No PrincipalId, account identity, session identity, CRM identity, or legal identity is exposed.
No private-project existence oracle is introduced.
runtimeBoundary: SESH_DB only through the SESH-055 runtime.
failureContract: No 404 state exists for the collection route.
rightsBoundary: Public presentation does not grant copyright, master, composition, publishing, distribution, label, management, royalty, licensing, revenue, collaborator, legal, CRM, account, or identity rights.
